block_bootstrap.method: date-block bootstrap (resample decision-date blocks with replacement)
block_bootstrap.block_length_rationale: Each block = all (stock) samples sharing one decision date (preserves cross-stock same-date dependence). sample_step=50 > max horizon=21 → same-stock windows do NOT overlap (overlap = max(0, 21-50) = 0). Cross-stock market-date dependence remains — that's why we block on date, not on sample.

phase2_baselines.description: Model vs zero-return + training-only-mean baselines, recomputed from raw predictions on the SAME eligible matured observations. Standard R² uses the evaluation-set mean as reference (NOT the zero-return or training-only-mean baseline) — positive R² means the model beats the eval-set mean, NOT necessarily the zero-return baseline.
phase2_baselines.sign_convention_relative_improvement: positive = model has lower error than baseline (better); negative = baseline is better

uncertainty_95ci.method: date-block bootstrap (resample 30 decision-date blocks with replacement, 1000 reps)
uncertainty_95ci.block_length_rationale: Each block = all (stock) samples sharing one decision date. Same-decision-date samples are correlated (same market conditions) → must stay together. Same-stock windows do NOT overlap: sample_step (50) > max horizon (21) → overlap = max(0, 21-50) = 0. Cross-stock same-date dependence remains.

phase4_stock_coverage.unavailable_reason: These universe symbols were selected at the point-in-time cutoff but produced 0 evaluable test-window samples (insufficient OHLCV history extending into the test window at the 50-session sampling interval). This is NOT hidden — it is reported.
phase4_stock_coverage.note: Per-stock metrics are kept SEPARATE from pooled cross-stock estimates. A positive pooled metric does NOT mean the model generalizes across all PSX stocks — it reflects these 24 stocks-with-samples only (BYCO has 0 samples). ENGRO has fewer samples (9) than the typical 17 because its CSV history ends earlier in the test window — this is honestly visible in samples_per_stock above.

phase5_ensemble_weights.weighting_description: EFFECTIVELY EQUAL-WEIGHTED among eligible models — every model earned weight 1.0 by exceeding the 50% validation-period win-rate threshold after the maturity purge. This is NOT a learned performance-based weighting strategy; it is a binary inclusion rule.
phase5_ensemble_weights.note: Weights were computed at finalization using ONLY validation-period outcomes (with maturity purge). Final-test outcomes did NOT influence the weights. Weights are frozen throughout final-test predictions. This task does NOT optimize or replace the weights — any new weighting must be developed on earlier validation data in a later task.

limitations: All uncertainty intervals are block-bootstrap 95% CIs from 30 decision-date blocks. 30 blocks is adequate for directional inference but narrow CIs should not be over-interpreted.

Positive standard R² means the model beats the EVALUATION-SET MEAN reference — it does NOT automatically mean the model beats the zero-return or training-only-mean baseline. Check the paired-improvement CIs for that.
A 95% CI for the paired MAE difference that is entirely below 0 means the model is significantly better than that baseline (lower error). A CI that includes 0 means NOT statistically significant.
Directional accuracy >50% is NOT statistically significant predictive skill without checking the CI and comparing to a sign-flip baseline.

Per-stock metrics are kept SEPARATE from pooled cross-stock estimates. A positive pooled metric does NOT mean the model generalizes across all PSX stocks — it reflects these 25 pilot25 universe stocks only.
Trading metrics (in the source report) are GROSS directional-return proxies, NOT net trading P&L.
The WIN_RATE_WEIGHTED ensemble with all weights = 1.0 is effectively EQUAL-WEIGHTED among eligible models — NOT a learned performance-based weighting strategy.
This robustness artifact is read-only — it does NOT modify walk_forward_latest.json or ml_predictions_multi.json.
